page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent processing capabilities.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance class highly efficient for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. By omitting local storage and GPU hardware, the instance maintains a streamlined resource profile, optimizing cost efficiency for raw CPU processing. Suitable workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive applications.
